description: How an address of a correctable value is named for a person. One table, tested twice: by backend/tests/unit/test_corrections_domain.py against domain/corrections.path_label (used by the Reasoning Delta narrative) and by frontend/tests/corrections.unit.spec.ts against lib/corrections.ts pathLabel (used by the Corrections card, the editor and the evidence rows). A new form of address needs a vector here, and both implementations must agree on it.
